source.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Score of \<2.
Participants must have a biopsy-proven solid malignancy (histologic proof or unequivocal cytologic proof solid tumor malignancy from either the primary or any metastatic site)
Patients with previous or other malignancies whose disease is controlled and not impacting ECOG performance or life expectancy.
